newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen stable on bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen stable on bargain-hunting.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen stable on Friday as bargain-hunting is seen in some second-liners and blue chips, while the newly-listed Bank Arya is likely to remain in focus, brokers said.
"The market is likely to be stable today. We expect bargain hunting in some second-liners such as Darya Varia to continue," one broker said.
Pharmaceutical firm Darya Varia staged a modest rebound on Thursday after recent sharp falls due to worries that first half net profits will be poor, brokers said.
Small-capitalised Bank Arya made a modest debut on Thursday as it closed at 1,150 rupiah, or 17.9 percent higher than the initial offer price of 975 rupiah.
On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index closed 0.71 points lower at 721.27 points.
